goal: Fix detached no-persistence and cancellation-after-committed-append consistency at the canonical owner/delivery boundary, with real E2E proof for normal, detached, and cancellation flows.
constraints: Strict RED→GREEN: capture the failing regression before production edits and rerun it unchanged after the fix.
Change at most five implementation/test files, excluding plan.md and goal.json.
Do not add configuration, protocol, or persistence-schema surfaces.
Do not use consumer-only guards, retries, larger timeouts, weakened assertions, or mock-only proof.
Do not push until the Reviewer gives final advance.
success_criteria: Normal delivery persists and reports committed output consistently.
Detached delivery does not lose committed output.
Cancellation after a committed append preserves and reports committed state consistently.
Real owner/delivery-boundary E2E covers all three flows.
Relevant tests and static checks pass; final diff stays within five repair files.
